title: [29.x]When Intrastat line is added manually the "Intrastat Country/Region Code" is not automatically populated after adding the "Country/Region Code"
summary: When users manually add an Intrastat report line and enter a Country/Region Code, the Intrastat Country/Region Code field is now automatically populated through an added validation trigger.
key_points: Added OnValidate trigger to Country/Region Code field on Intrastat Report Line table
Automatically derives Intrastat Country/Region Code when user enters Country/Region Code
Fixes issue where manual line entry did not populate Intrastat code unlike the Suggest Lines path
Includes test coverage for the new behavior
quote: Added an OnValidate trigger on Country/Region Code that sets Intrastat Country/Region Code.
